caption: The drawing features a scene divided vertically into two main sections. On the left side, there are several figures, most wearing hats or helmets in shades of white, blue, and brown. One person is riding a yellow horse. At the center left, a figure in a white robe and brown hair is kneeling on the ground, holding a large wooden cross, while another figure appears to be helping or forcing him. Additional figures surround them, some watching and some gesturing with their hands. Behind the group, ornate blue and gray decorative patterns fill the background, suggesting an architectural or tapestry element. On the right side, a group of people, most wearing elaborate hats or head coverings, are seen behind a stone or wooden barrier colored in gray-blue. Two women, one in a blue mantle and another with long brown hair, are positioned in the foreground. The color palette consists primarily of muted earth tones—browns, blues, grays, and beiges—with some soft red and yellow accents. The overall composition directs attention to the central figure carrying the cross, and the two groups are separated by a central architectural feature or column adorned in blue organic patterns. The text at the top left reads "Jesus falls the second time," and a small signature is present at the bottom right.
title: Station of the Cross No. 7: "Jesus Falls the Second Time"
